answer: Cap each verified operator to a small garden of identity plots, and make every extra plot cost more to tend than the last: the upkeep fee doubles with each additional identity, so an attacker who tries to forge a thousand fake agents faces an exploding upkeep bill instead of one flat fee. The registry counts plots per operator proof on-chain and rejects new registrations once the fee for that tier is unpaid, while a public jetty queue shows every pending plot so duplicates are spotted before they dock.
